notes: Desktop/rack-mountable field unit (no rackUnits specified by AJA as a standard rack size; it's typically deployed on a mounting tray/sled rather than a fixed RU chassis, so rackUnits omitted). Two PAK SSD media bays exist but are storage slots, not physical cabling I/O, so omitted per port scope. Two power inputs are redundant (either/or, not both required): 4-pin XLR DC (12-18V) or AC adapter (100-240VAC). SDI: 1x 12G-SDI + 3x 3G-SDI on both input and output sides, plus a dedicated 3G-SDI monitor output; optional SFP fiber/HD-BNC modules can replace the BNC SDI cages (not modeled separately here since they are alternate/optional physical options on the same ports, not additional simultaneous ports). Audio I/O uses DB-25 TASCAM-pinout connectors (8-ch balanced analog in, 8-ch balanced analog out, 8-ch AES/EBU in, 8-ch AES/EBU out) — DB-25 is not in the allowed connector-id list, so these are approximated as xlr3 (analog) and aes3 (digital); this is a notable caveat since the physical connector is actually a multi-pin D-sub, not a native XLR or AES3 jack, though AJA does bundle XLR breakout cables. Reference video has 2 BNCs described as "looping" (in + loop-through), not independently gradeable. Cross-verified via AJA official product page (aja.com), B&H product listing, and the AJA Ki Pro Ultra 12G Installation & Operation Manual (rear panel diagram via ManualsLib) — all three sources agree on port counts and types.

ports.name: Analog Audio In (DB-25 TASCAM, 8-ch balanced)
ports.note: Physical connector is a DB-25 (TASCAM pinout) carrying 8 channels of balanced analog audio; AJA ships XLR breakout looms. DB-25 is not in the allowed connector list, so it is represented here as XLR3 (closest real equivalent) — treat as approximate.

ports.name: Analog Audio Out (DB-25 TASCAM, 8-ch balanced)
ports.note: Physical connector is a DB-25 (TASCAM pinout) carrying 8 channels of balanced analog audio; AJA ships XLR breakout looms. DB-25 is not in the allowed connector list, so it is represented here as XLR3 (closest real equivalent) — treat as approximate.

ports.name: AES/EBU In (DB-25 TASCAM, 8-ch)
ports.note: Physical connector is a DB-25 (TASCAM pinout) carrying 8 channels of AES/EBU digital audio, represented here as AES3 since DB-25 is not in the allowed connector list.

ports.name: AES/EBU Out (DB-25 TASCAM, 8-ch)
ports.note: Physical connector is a DB-25 (TASCAM pinout) carrying 8 channels of AES/EBU digital audio, represented here as AES3 since DB-25 is not in the allowed connector list.

ports.name: AC Power In (adapter)
ports.note: AJA specifies a detachable 100-240VAC adapter; exact adapter-side inlet connector (likely IEC C13/C14 or C7) not explicitly confirmed on manufacturer page — represented as IEC as the closest standard mains inlet.
